I will explore how car weight relates to fuel efficiency and compare
average miles per gallon across cylinder groups.

Data: [Motor Trend Car Road Tests](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/datasets/html/mtcars.html),
available as the built-in mtcars dataset in R.
It contains information about 32 cars from the 1973–74 model years.
